shortDescription: Tata Sons’ board is set to discuss the Reserve Bank of India’s IPO mandate and whether outgoing Chairman Natarajan Chandrasekaran should be asked to stay on, according to Bloomberg.The board is also facing a leadership dilemma as it considers the chairman transition.

title: Tata Sons Board Weighs RBI IPO Mandate and Chandrasekaran Succession
